title: Billy Eckstine, Harry Belafonte, Billy Daniels and Pha Terrell
summary: Humes praises Billy Eckstine, has never met Harry Belafonte, remembers working with Billy Daniels at the Famous Door, and plans to sing Pha Terrell's 'When the Real Thing Comes Along'.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Well listen, what's the name of Mr. Jelly Jelly?
Oh, Billy Eckstine.
What about Billy Eckstine?
Oh he's so great. And you know his little daughter is great too.
Really? I didn't know, really?
Yeah.
Fancy that. I didn't know that. He is a trumpet player.
Yeah.

Yeah.
And here's another name that escaped me, Belafonte.
I don't know her.
You don't? Well you know you do that calypso thing.
Yeah.
